narration: The cloth catches each sliding pebble before it reaches the glass channel. You cross unheard and reach the burned guard post above the next street. Below, a sinkhole has opened through the boulevard. Two Circle guards in old plague masks wait on opposite sides, watching the obvious approaches but not your ledge. Between them, a mud-sled bears fresh crates stamped with the erased apothecary exemption.

ruling.understoodAction: Resolve the muffled crossing with Stealth 18 against DC 13.
ruling.ruling: Success; the alarm remains silent and Mira reaches the next segment unseen.
